extracted.intended_audience: Heads of Executive Departments and Establishments
extracted.subtask_description: Official memorandum rescinding specified portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 and directing Executive Branch agencies to follow OMB Circular No. A-11 for the derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings. Also clarifies that position management provisions of A-64 remain in effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of instructions on employment ceilings
rubrics_metrics.description: All instructions from the Executive Office of the President related to the development, implementation, or revision of employment ceilings should be consolidated in a single instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As suggested by the Assistant Secretaries for Management Group, agencies are to look to a single consolidated instruction rather than multiple scattered documents. The memorandum points agencies to OMB Circular No. A-11 (Transmittal Memorandum No. 54) as that consolidated instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersession of A-64 employment ceiling provisions by A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective with the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983, the provisions of Circular No. A-64 pertaining to employment ceilings and Bulletin No. 83-5 are superseded by relevant portions of Circular No. A-11 (e.g., section 13 and Appendix D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must follow the relevant portions of Circular No. A-11 (notably section 13 and Appendix D) for matters previously governed by A-64 and Bulletin 83-5.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific portions of A-64 rescinded
rubrics_metrics.description: The memorandum explicitly rescinds the following portions of Circular No. A-64: (a) References to employment ceilings in section 1 (Policy); (b) References to employment ceilings in section 2(c); (c) Sections 4, 5 and 6; and (d) Attachment C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These enumerated sections and attachment of A-64 no longer govern employment ceiling matters; agencies should not rely on them for employment ceiling policy or procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of FTE ceilings now in A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: With the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, all instructions regarding the derivation, issuance, monitoring and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings are contained in that Circular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational activities and reporting related to FTE ceilings (derivation methods, issuance processes, monitoring regimes, reporting requirements) must conform to the procedures and requirements set forth in Circular No. A-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position management systems provisions remain in effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 that pertain to position management systems remain in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although A-64's employment ceiling provisions are superseded, agencies should continue to follow the A-64 provisions that address position management systems until further notice or revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective reference date and document
rubrics_metrics.description: The change takes effect with OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should use A-11 Transmittal Memorandum No. 54 (July 19, 1983) as the controlling document and reference point for the revised location of employment ceiling instructions.
